caseName: Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen v. Virginia ex rel. Virginia State Bar
caseNameFull: Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen v. Virginia ex rel. Virginia State Bar
attorneys: Wayland B. Cedarquist on the motion.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 372 U. S. 905, to the Supreme Court of Appeals of Virginia. The motion of the American Bar Association for leave to participate in oral argument, as amicus curiae, is denied.
